description: Pinned rendering: a brace-less indented line is a sibling, so tag is rejected under the document root as KDLITH-BND001, and because the item written above it admits tag as a child and tag is indented past it, the error carries a note at item's line asking whether tag was meant to nest there; input.kdl is a byte copy of invalid/data/indented-line-not-child/input.kdl so the golden pins scenario-relative locations
